scripts.name: build
scripts.command: xcodebuild -project MacNote.xcodeproj -scheme MacNote -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

scripts.name: run
scripts.command: xcodebuild -project MacNote.xcodeproj -scheme MacNote -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -derivedDataPath build build && killall MacNote 2>/dev/null; open -n build/Build/Products/Debug/MacNote.app
